documents.title: Accessibility statement
documents.refusal_reason: An accessibility statement is a public commitment about conformance and about the feedback route, and it is enforceable.

documents.title: Accessibility conformance report (VPAT)
documents.refusal_reason: An ACR generated from automated tooling covers a minority of the success criteria and zero assistive-technology testing. Handing one to a public-sector buyer misrepresents conformance.

documents.title: AI Act Annex IV technical documentation
documents.refusal_reason: Annex IV documentation is retained for ten years and inaccuracy is itself an infringement.

documents.title: Authority to operate
documents.refusal_reason: An authority to operate is a signed acceptance of residual risk by an accountable executive.

documents.title: Business associate agreement
documents.refusal_reason: A business associate agreement is a contract between two organisations. Drafting a contract is not a documentation task.

documents.title: Cyber Resilience Act technical documentation
documents.refusal_reason: The technical file is a conformity instrument retained for regulator inspection.

documents.title: Data processing agreement and subprocessor list
EU declaration of conformity
documents.refusal_reason: A declaration of conformity is a signed legal statement that a product meets EU requirements.

documents.title: General purpose AI model documentation
documents.refusal_reason: Model documentation under the GPAI obligations is a regulator-facing instrument.

documents.title: HIPAA security risk assessment
documents.refusal_reason: A security risk assessment is a regulated deliverable under the HIPAA Security Rule and is evidence a covered entity or business associate stands behind. docdna writes the inventory that feeds it and refuses the assessment itself.

documents.title: Impact assessment (DPIA, PIA, AIA or FRIA)
documents.refusal_reason: An impact assessment is a legally binding analysis submitted to a regulator. An inadequate one breaches the obligation directly and, worse, stops the organisation doing a real one.
documents.signed_by: the privacy officer, and the regulator receives it

documents.title: PCI self-assessment questionnaire or attestation of compliance
documents.refusal_reason: A self-assessment questionnaire is a signed attestation to an acquirer. docdna records scope and refuses the attestation.
documents.signed_by: a qualified security assessor or the merchant's officer

documents.title: Penetration test report
documents.refusal_reason: A penetration test report describes tests somebody ran. docdna runs nothing.

documents.title: Security assessment and authorization package
documents.refusal_reason: An SA&A package asserts control implementation and is signed by a departmental authorizer. Drafting 'AC-2 implemented' because a grep found an IAM role is a false control assertion in an authorization package.

documents.title: Secure design review record
documents.refusal_reason: A design review records what reviewers actually concluded. Inventing that record fabricates a human judgement.
documents.signed_by: the reviewers named in the record

documents.title: SOC 2 system description
documents.refusal_reason: The system description is written by the organisation and attested by a licensed CPA firm. A generated description asserts controls nobody confirmed, in the one document an auditor reads first.
documents.signed_by: management, attested by the service auditor

documents.title: Secure software development attestation
documents.refusal_reason: A secure development attestation is signed by a company officer and carries legal consequence for a false statement.

documents.title: Security training records
documents.refusal_reason: Training records assert that named people completed training on named dates.

documents.title: Definition of Ready / Definition of Done
